title: Bioceb - European Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy
about: Bioceb, an Erasmus Mundus joint master's in biological and chemical engineering for a sustainable bioeconomy, accepts applications for its 2027-2029 cohort via the AgroParisTech portal until 19 January 2027, 11:30 Paris time.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Bioceb - European Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy at Bioceb Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (AgroParisTech), France, deadline 19 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
